q: The Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy of a stationary ergodic process {Xₙ} equals the entropy rate H̄ of the process. This connection is stated precisely as:
opts: h_μ(T) = H(X₀ | X_{-1}, X_{-2}, …) = lim H(Xₙ|X₁,…,Xₙ₋₁)
exp: The KS entropy of the stationary measure μ on the shift space equals the entropy rate: h_μ(σ) = H(X₀|X_{-∞}^{-1}) = lim_{n→∞} H(Xₙ|X₁,…,Xₙ₋₁). This unifies Shannon's entropy rate (information theory) with Kolmogorov's measure-theoretic entropy.
